EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: BD/HE/LND/5/54. Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms Reference

No. 4-3/9/2015/WS/88. I, hereby give notice under sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.

Thirteen (13) allotments of land in total extent 0.3508 Hectare depicted in final Village Plan No. 176 supplement No. 28 Sheet No. 28, Plan No. 176 supplement No. 29 Sheet No. 29 and dated 16.09.2017 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in Bogoda Village, in the Grama Niladhari Division of 73A, Hapuwalakumbura, in the Hali Ela Divisional Secretary’s Division, in the District of Badulla, in Uva Province, more fully described as follows.

1 . Lot No. 263 Name of the Land: Not known; Description: Garden and 5-10 years old mix cultivation; Claimants: State; Encroached by Duglas Silva Nanayakkara, 8th Mile, post, Oduoowara, Demodera: Extent: 0.0075 Hectare.
North: Lot No. 262, 260 and 264; East: Lot No. 264; South: Lot No. 264, 266 and Road (Road Development Authority); West: Road (Road Development Authority) and Lot No. 262.

2 . Lot No. 264 Name of the Land: Odoowara Watta; Description: Home Garden and 5-10 years old coconut tree and mix cultivation and permanent building; Claimants : Duglas Silva Nanayakkara, 8th Mile, Post, Badulla Road, Odoowara, Demodera: Extent: 0.0602 Hectare.

North: Lot Nos. 263, 262, 260, 261 and 265; East: Lot Nos. 265, 269 and 268; South: Lot Nos. 268, 267 Road (Road Development Authority), and Lot Nos. 266, 263; West: Road (Road Development Authority), Lot Nos. 266, 263, 262 and 260.

3 . Lot No. 265 Name of the Land: Not known; Description: Garden and 5-10 years old mix cultivation; Claimants: State; Encroached by Duglas Silva Nanayakkara, 8th Mile, post, Oduoowara, Demodera: Extent: 0.0140 Hectare.
North: Lot No. 261 and Badullu Oya (river); East: Badullu Oya (river) Lot No. 269; South: Lot Nos. 269, 268 and 264; West: Lot Nos. 264, 260 and 261.
4 . Lot No. 266 Name of the Land: Not known; Description: Road (Road Development Authority); Claimants: Not known. (Part of Lot No. 8); Extent: 0.0008 Hectare.
Note: Lot Number 266,s boundaries not mention. 5 . Lot No. 267 Name of the Land: Not known; Description: Streem; Claimants: State; (Part of old Road Lot No. not known): Extent: 0.0009 Hectare.

East: Lot No. 8 and 271; South: Lot No. 271 and 274;West: Lot No. 274 and 270.

All persons interested one or more of the above said lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Hali-Ela on the relevant day at the prescribed time as appearing in the under mentioned time schedule of title inquiries, and also are required to forward to me on or before 27.12.2017 in writing (in duplicate) their interests in the said lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation and other entitlements for acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and entitlements and the details of such amount.
